senses.gloss:
इत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; returned; obtained; re-
membered; (अम्), n. way.
—इतासु (˚त-अस्˚), उस्, उस्,
उ, Ved. whose vital spirits have departed.

इतर इ-तर, अस्, आ, अत्, Ved. अम् (comparative
form of pronom. base 3. इ; cf. Lat. iterum; Hib. iter),
the other (of two), another; (pl.) the rest; (with
abl.) different from; low, vile; expelled, rejected;
इतर इतर, the one — the other, this — that. (इतर
connected antithetically with a preceding word often
signifies the contrary idea, e. g. विजयाय इतराय
वा, to victory or defeat; so in Dvandva compounds,
सुखेतरेषु, in happiness and distress. It some-
times, however, forms a Tat-puruṣa compound with
another word to express the one idea implied in the
contrary of that word, e. g. दक्षिणेतर, the left
hand.)
—इतर-जन, आस्, m. pl. other men; a euphe-
mistic title of certain beings who appear to be consi-
dered as spirits of darkness; Kuvera belongs to them.
—इतर-तस्, ind. otherwise than, different from;
इतश्चेतरतश्च, hither and thither.
—इतर-था,
ind. in another manner, in a contrary manner; per-
versely; on the other hand, else.
इतरा, f., N. of the mother of Aitareya.

इतरेतर, अस्, आ, अम् (occurring chiefly in oblique
cases of sing. and in comp.; fr. इतर-इतर, which
may be for इतरस्-इतर, cf. अन्योऽन्य, परस्-
पर), one another, one with another, mutual, re-
spective, several; (अम्), n. or adv. mutually, &c.
—इतरेतर-काम्या, f. respective or several fancies
or inclinations.
—इतरेतराश्रय (˚र-आश्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, affecting or concerning mutually.
इतरे-द्युस्, ind. at another or different day.

इ-तम, अस्, आ, अत् (superlative form of 3. इ), another
(of many ?).

इतस् इ-तस्, ind. (fr. 3. इ with affix तस्, used
like the abl. case of the pronoun इदम्), from hence,
hence, here (opposed to अमु-तस् and अमु-त्र);
from this point; from this world, in this world; इतस्
इतस्, here — there; इतश्चेतश्च, hence and thence,
hither and thither, here and there, to and fro; from
this time, now; therefore.
—इत-ऊति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
extending or reaching from hence; existing or lasting
longer than the present time, future; (Sāy.) one who
has obtained help.
—इतस्-ततस्, ind. here and there,
hither and thither.
